Early Advisory for Flood Preparedness
Based on forecasts issued by the Department of Meteorology, enhanced rainfall is expected in river basins
located within the Uva, Eastern, Central, North Central, and Northern Provinces. Consequently, there is
an increased risk of flooding in the river basins of the districts of Ampara, Batticaloa, Polonnaruwa,
Anuradhapura, Trincomalee, Vavuniya, and Jaffna.
Accordingly, residents living in low-lying areas along river valleys and in close proximity to rivers within
these districts are strongly advised to exercise heightened vigilance. Furthermore, relevant disaster
management authorities are requested to treat this matter with utmost priority and implement all
necessary preparedness and mitigation measures.
